items.question: What measured quantities of molasses are prescribed as suitable for the oblation?
premises: Molasses is specified as a material for the oblation.
One prescribed quantity of molasses is a karṣa-measure.
Another prescribed quantity of molasses is a half-pala-measure.
items.inference: Molasses in quantities of one karṣa and half a pala is suitable for use in the oblation.
uncertainties: The exact syntactic coordination between the two measure expressions is somewhat compressed.
items.plain_english: Molasses measuring one karṣa and molasses measuring half a pala are suitable for the oblation.
